secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side admin operations (found in Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → service_role key). A placeholder is generated for dev; replace with the real key for cloud sync features.

secrets.name: AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the AI gateway used for chat and image generation. Replace with your provider's key (OpenAI, Google AI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_URL
secrets.description: Chat completions endpoint URL. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions if not set.

secrets.name: AI_IMAGES_URL
secrets.description: Image generations endpoint URL. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations if not set.

secrets.name: CRON_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret for authenticating cron job requests. A placeholder is generated for dev.
